newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SAS, United Airlines get alliance approval.
newsitem.headline: SAS, United Airlines get alliance approval.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System said Tuesday that the U.S. Department of Transportation had granted it and UAL Corp.'s United Airlines antitrust immunity for their marketing alliance.
"This means that SAS and United can extend and strengthen their marketing cooperation and develop an effective, global network of services to the benefit of travelers," SAS said in a statement.
It said the Department of Transport had also granted antitrust immunity for the three-party alliance among SAS, United and German carrier Lufthansa.
"The approval of our application for immunity ... is an important legal milestone in the continued development of our cooperation," SAS said.
SAS and United entered into an alliance in September 1995 regarding flights over the North Atlantic, the United States and Europe.
SAS said the immunity would allow them to integrate their traffic and line planning to help them compete against other global alliances.
"SAS and United will now be looking closer at the potential synergies in marketing and distribution, information systems, purchasing and joint product development," SAS said.
